The Makeover Room — Bridal Makeup & Hair, Hyderabad

The Makeover Room is a Hyderabad bridal studio offering both Hyderabadi/Nizami
bridal looks and modern glam styles, with a focus on long-wear makeup suited to
long wedding functions and warm weather.

Their bridal package (two events) is ₹65,000, including a trial, hairstyling, and
draping. Family makeup and additional events are charged separately.

Contact: +91 91000 24489 · book@makeoverroom.example
Location: Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (147 reviews)

What couples say:
"Makeup held up through a long, warm outdoor ceremony."

The Makeover Room emphasizes long-wear, heat-resistant makeup and is experienced
